transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because, well, for the last few weeks I've barely had an appetite. It's just... even foods I usually like to grab after a long shift, they just sit there. I end up having to force down a few bites, and that's about it.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

Yeah, I guess you could say that. Most days lately, I just feel... I don't know, heavy. It's this flat feeling I carry around with me. Even when I'm at home with my family or just sitting in the break room at work, I feel like I'm just going through the motions. Like I'm not really there, you know? Just down.
Have you lost any weight recently?

Yeah, I probably have. Like I mentioned a minute ago about not really having an appetite... since I'm mostly just forcing down a few bites after my shifts, I'm sure I've dropped a few pounds. I haven't actually stepped on a scale to check, but my uniform pants are definitely fitting a little looser around the waist than they were a few weeks ago.
Would you say you've lost more than 5% of your body weight over the past month?

I couldn't say for sure if it's five percent, since I haven't stepped on a scale to check the exact numbers. But like I was saying earlier, the main reason I came in is because for the last few weeks, my appetite is just gone. I get off my shift, and even food I normally look forward to just sits there. I really only force down a few bites a day, so it honestly wouldn't surprise me if I've lost that much.
Have you noticed any significant change in your clothing size or fit over the past few weeks?

Yeah, like I mentioned a minute ago, my work uniform is definitely fitting looser on me. It really just comes back to what I was saying—for the last few weeks, I’ve barely had an appetite at all. Even the foods I usually like to eat after a shift just sit there in front of me, and I just end up forcing down a few bites. So, yeah, I've definitely noticed a change in how my clothes fit because of that.
Have you experienced any weight loss that you would consider significant?

Well, like I keep mentioning, I'm not sure about the exact numbers on a scale. But I'd say it's significant just because of why it's happening. The whole reason I came in is because for the last few weeks, I’ve barely had an appetite at all. Even the foods I usually really like to eat after my shift just sit there, and I just end up forcing down a few bites. So yeah, losing weight because of that feels significant to me.
Do you worry about your weight?

No, not really. I'm not trying to lose weight or stressing over how I look, if that's what you mean. It's just happening because I'm not eating. So, no, the weight itself isn't really something I worry about.
Do you often feel guilty or blame yourself for things?
No, not really. I mean, I don't think I walk around feeling guilty or beating myself up over things. I just feel... tired, mostly. But no, I wouldn't say I blame myself or feel guilty about stuff.
Have you been exercising more than usual over the past few weeks?
No, definitely not. I mean, I'm just too tired lately. I do my shifts at work and that's about it. I haven't been working out or doing any extra exercise at all.
Do you think your loss of appetite is related to your feelings of sadness?

Yeah, I suppose it is. I mean, most days I just feel like I'm carrying this heavy, flat feeling around with me. It's like... even when I'm home with my family or just sitting in the break room at work, I'm just not really there. So, yeah, I guess when you feel like that all the time, eating just doesn't really cross your mind.
Are you trying to lose weight?
No, not at all. I'm not on a diet or trying to drop pounds or anything like that. It's just... like I said, I just don't really have the drive to eat right now. It's definitely not on purpose.
Do you think your body weight or shape is abnormal?

No, I don't think so. I mean... I just look like I usually do. Maybe a little thinner lately since I haven't been eating much, but... no, I don't think my body or my shape is abnormal or anything like that. It's just a normal body.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No, not really. I mean, I'm just a regular guy. Gaining weight isn't something I really worry about or... or fear, you know? It's just that I don't have the appetite for food right now.
Are you happy about the weight you've lost?
No, I wouldn't say I'm happy about it. It's just... something that's happening because I haven't been eating. I don't really care one way or the other about the weight, honestly.
Do you feel like you would be happier if you lost more weight?
No, not at all. Losing weight wouldn't make me happier. I don't really care about my weight... it's just not something I think about. I'm just not hungry.
